templates.name: Creative Writing
templates.description: Vivid story or scene with strong voice, pacing and imagery.
templates.template:
Write a {length} {genre} piece about {subject}.

Constraints:
- Point of view: {pov}
- Tone: {tone}
- Include: vivid sensory detail, subtext, a satisfying turn near the end
- Avoid: clichés, purple prose, deus ex machina

Deliver the piece first, then a 3-bullet note on the choices you made.

templates.name: Code Debug
templates.description: Diagnose a bug with evidence and ranked fixes.

templates.name: Research Brief
templates.description: Structured, sourced overview of a topic.
templates.template:
Act as a research assistant. Produce a {length} brief on {topic}.

Structure:
1. TL;DR (3 bullets)
2. Key facts with dates and numbers
3. Main perspectives/disagreements
4. Open questions
5. Suggested next sources

Rules: separate established facts from speculation; flag uncertainty explicitly; no filler.

templates.name: Product Description
templates.description: Punchy e-commerce copy with benefits first.
templates.template:
Write a product description for {product}.

Audience: {audience}
Tone: {tone}
Key benefits (in this order): {benefits}

Format:
- Headline (max 8 words)
- 2-sentence hook
- 4–6 benefit bullets (benefit before feature)
- Spec list
- CTA

Avoid: hype words (revolutionary, game-changing), exclamation marks.

templates.name: Code Review
templates.template:
Review the following {language} code as a senior engineer.

```
{code}
```

For each finding give: severity (blocker/major/minor/nit), the line or snippet, why it matters, and a concrete fix.
Check: correctness, edge cases, naming, complexity, security, tests.
End with: overall verdict (approve / approve-with-changes / request-changes) and the single highest-impact improvement.

templates.name: Interview Questions
templates.description: Tailored question set with evaluation criteria.
templates.template:
Generate {count} interview questions for a {role} candidate.

Focus areas: {focus_areas}
Mix: 40% behavioral, 40% technical, 20% situational.

For each question add:
- What it tests
- A strong answer outline
- Red flags to watch for

Avoid trivia; prefer questions that reveal judgment.

templates.name: Summarize Anything
templates.template:
Summarize the following {content_type}.

Give me:
1. TL;DR — 3 bullets, each ≤ 15 words
2. Key details — the facts, numbers and names I'd need to act
3. Open loops — unresolved questions or risks
4. Suggested actions — 3 concrete next steps

If anything is ambiguous, ask me up to 2 clarifying questions first.

templates.name: Email Polish
templates.description: Rewrite an email for clarity and tone.

templates.name: Learn a Topic
templates.description: Personalized lesson with checks for understanding.
templates.template:
Teach me {topic}. My level: {level}. My goal: {goal}.

Plan:
- Start from what someone at my level already knows
- Explain in layers: intuition → mechanism → formal detail
- Use 1 concrete example and 1 analogy
- After each layer, ask me 1 check-for-understanding question and wait
- Finish with 3 exercises from easy to hard

templates.name: Extract Structure
templates.description: Turn messy text into clean structured data.
templates.template:
Extract structured data from the text below.

Return ONLY valid JSON matching this schema:
{schema}

Rules: use null for unknown values; normalize dates to ISO 8601; do not invent values.

Text:
"""
{text}
"""
